Operations Function — IPAK Group

Operations OrganizationalStructureStructure

Hierarchy, evaluation and grade alignment — from the COO down to plant-floor execution across IPAK | CPAK, PETPAK and GPAK.
Operations Division
1Operations Structure Concept

Five principles behind the structure

What shapes how Operations is organized, top to bottom.
Plant-wise ownershipOne Plant Head each for IPAK|CPAK, PETPAK, GPAK
Filmline vs. OfflineFilm production separated from slitting, packing & carpentry
Shift-based accountabilityEvery line run by 4 shift incharges under a Team Lead
Shared IPAK | CPAK linesFilmline, silo & offline sections serve both brands
Standardized gradingSM · MM · JM banding with a ceiling at every tier
2Organizational Flow

Six tiers, COO to plant floor

How decisions cascade through Operations.
01Business UnitCOO — Head of BU
02DivisionGroup Head Operations
03FunctionPlant Head — IPAK|CPAK, PETPAK, GPAK
04SectionSection Head — Filmline / Offline
05Team LeadLine Team Lead — Metallizer, Slitter, Packing…
06Sub-SectionIncharge, Shift Incharge, Process Engineer, then operators, packers & support staff

Technical OrganizationalStructureStructure

Hierarchy, evaluation and grade alignment — from the COO down to plant-level technical execution across Utility & Maintenance, Electrical, Powerplant, Projects and Civil.
Technical Division
1Technical Structure Concept

Five principles behind the structure

What shapes how Technical is organized, top to bottom.
Three-tier leadershipDirector, Group Head and Dy. Group Head under the COO
Brand-cluster sectionsIPAK/CPAK and PETPAK/GPAK run separate sections
Shift-based maintenanceShift incharges and maintenance engineers cover every shift
Central planning & projectsTech Planning, Projects and Civil serve the whole group
Standardized gradingSM · MM · JM banding with a ceiling at every tier

Six tiers, COO to shop floor

How decisions cascade through Technical.
01Business UnitCOO — Head of BU
02DivisionDirector, Group Head & Dy. Group Head Technical
03FunctionGroup Heads: U&M, Electrical, Powerplant — plus Tech Planning, Projects, Civil
04SectionSection Heads per brand cluster
05Team LeadTeam Leads — shift engineering & planning
06Sub-SectionShift Incharges, Maint. Engineers, then technicians, electricians, operators & support staff

Finance & Treasury OrganizationalStructureStructure

Hierarchy, evaluation and grade alignment — from the CSO down to section-level execution across Treasury, Accounts, Taxation, Reporting, Insurance and EFS.
Strategy, Performance & Control Division
1Finance & Treasury Structure Concept

Five principles behind the structure

What shapes how Finance & Treasury is organized, top to bottom.
Single division headHead of Division owns finance end to end under the CSO
Treasury vs. AccountsFunding & banking separated from bookkeeping & payables
Specialist sectionsTaxation, Reporting & Costing, Insurance and EFS
Strategy unitStrategy sits alongside the finance functions
Standardized gradingMM · JM banding for equity across teams
